package.name: e2e_sim_safety
package.description: L5-flavored end-to-end test (claude-docs/12-testing.md, milestone 1): launches racer_gym_bridge's bridge_node and racer_safety's safety_node together through the REAL command path (/drive_raw -> safety_node -> /drive -> bridge_node, no test-only remaps -- unlike tests/l5_tracker_lap, which needed remaps because no safety_node existed yet), feeds scripted /drive_raw, asserts the sim pose advances, then stops /drive_raw and asserts the watchdog zeroes /drive. This package has no library code of its own -- it exists only to host this integration test, which needs both racer_gym_bridge and racer_safety built and installed together (see .github/scripts/e2e_sim_safety_test.sh).
